observation_window.label: observation_window
observation_window.name: Observation window
observation_window.description: The time span covered by a single telemetry entryset, marking when the reported values were captured.
observation_window.comment: Always present; used to index entrysets by time

vehicle_identity.label: vehicle_identity
vehicle_identity.name: Vehicle identity
vehicle_identity.description: Identifying information for the specific vehicle a telemetry entryset belongs to.
vehicle_identity.comment: Always present; used to index entrysets by vehicle

trip_context.label: trip_context
trip_context.name: Trip context
trip_context.description: Identifiers linking a telemetry entryset to a specific trip, driver, and route.
trip_context.comment: Usually present; missing for unattended or test drives

gps_position.label: gps_position
gps_position.name: GPS position
gps_position.description: The vehicle's geographic position at the time of the entryset, from its onboard GPS receiver.
gps_position.comment: Nearly always present; occasionally missing on GPS signal loss

engine_rpm.label: engine_rpm
engine_rpm.name: Engine RPM
engine_rpm.description: The rotational speed of the engine's crankshaft, one of the most frequently sampled engine signals.

engine_oil_temperature.label: engine_oil_temperature
engine_oil_temperature.name: Engine oil temperature
engine_oil_temperature.description: The temperature of the engine oil, used to gauge lubrication effectiveness and engine wear risk.

engine_oil_pressure.label: engine_oil_pressure
engine_oil_pressure.name: Engine oil pressure
engine_oil_pressure.description: The pressure of oil circulating through the engine, critical to preventing bearing and component wear.
engine_oil_pressure.comment: Low pressure can indicate a pump or leak fault

engine_coolant_temperature.label: engine_coolant_temperature
engine_coolant_temperature.name: Engine coolant temperature
engine_coolant_temperature.description: The temperature of coolant flowing through the engine block, a key overheating indicator.
engine_coolant_temperature.comment: Feeds the thermostat and cooling fan logic

engine_load.label: engine_load
engine_load.name: Engine load
engine_load.description: The calculated percentage of available engine torque currently being used.
engine_load.comment: Correlates with throttle position and fuel use

turbocharger_boost_pressure.label: turbocharger_boost_pressure
turbocharger_boost_pressure.name: Turbocharger boost pressure
turbocharger_boost_pressure.description: The intake pressure produced by the turbocharger above atmospheric pressure.
turbocharger_boost_pressure.comment: Higher boost means more power, more heat

spark_plug_condition.label: spark_plug_condition
spark_plug_condition.name: Spark plug condition
spark_plug_condition.description: The wear and firing condition of an individual cylinder's spark plug.

camshaft_position.label: camshaft_position
camshaft_position.name: Camshaft position
camshaft_position.description: The rotational angle of the camshaft relative to top dead center, used for valve timing.

crankshaft_position.label: crankshaft_position
crankshaft_position.name: Crankshaft position
crankshaft_position.description: The rotational angle and speed of the crankshaft, the primary timing reference for engine control.
crankshaft_position.comment: Loss of signal typically stalls the engine

transmission_gear.label: transmission_gear
transmission_gear.name: Transmission gear
transmission_gear.description: The currently engaged gear in the transmission.
transmission_gear.comment: Changes with speed and load demand

transmission_fluid_temperature.label: transmission_fluid_temperature
transmission_fluid_temperature.name: Transmission fluid temperature
transmission_fluid_temperature.description: The temperature of the fluid lubricating and cooling the transmission.

clutch_wear.label: clutch_wear
clutch_wear.name: Clutch wear
clutch_wear.description: The estimated wear level of the clutch assembly based on engagement history.

differential_temperature.label: differential_temperature
differential_temperature.name: Differential temperature
differential_temperature.description: The temperature of a drive axle's differential housing and gear oil.
differential_temperature.comment: Tracked per axle on multi-axle vehicles

driveshaft_torque.label: driveshaft_torque
driveshaft_torque.name: Driveshaft torque
driveshaft_torque.description: The torque currently being transmitted through the driveshaft to the wheels.
driveshaft_torque.comment: Spikes under hard acceleration or towing

cv_joint_condition.label: cv_joint_condition
cv_joint_condition.name: CV joint condition
cv_joint_condition.description: The condition of a constant-velocity joint's protective boot and grease seal.
cv_joint_condition.comment: A torn boot leads to rapid joint failure

transfer_case_mode.label: transfer_case_mode
transfer_case_mode.name: Transfer case mode
transfer_case_mode.description: The currently selected drive mode on a vehicle's transfer case, for multi-axle drive vehicles.
transfer_case_mode.comment: Relevant to 4x4 and AWD fleet vehicles

torque_converter_lockup.label: torque_converter_lockup
torque_converter_lockup.name: Torque converter lockup
torque_converter_lockup.description: Whether the automatic transmission's torque converter is mechanically locked for direct drive.

fuel_level.label: fuel_level
fuel_level.name: Fuel level
fuel_level.description: The amount of fuel remaining in the tank.
fuel_level.comment: One of the most frequently reported signals

fuel_pressure.label: fuel_pressure
fuel_pressure.name: Fuel pressure
fuel_pressure.description: The pressure of fuel delivered to the injectors by the fuel pump.

fuel_injector_status.label: fuel_injector_status
fuel_injector_status.name: Fuel injector status
fuel_injector_status.description: The operating condition and pulse timing of an individual fuel injector.

fuel_pump_status.label: fuel_pump_status
fuel_pump_status.name: Fuel pump status
fuel_pump_status.description: The operating state and delivery rate of the fuel pump.
fuel_pump_status.comment: A failing pump causes intermittent stalling

fuel_consumption_rate.label: fuel_consumption_rate
fuel_consumption_rate.name: Fuel consumption rate
fuel_consumption_rate.description: The rate at which the vehicle is currently consuming fuel.
fuel_consumption_rate.comment: Key metric for fleet efficiency reporting

fuel_tank_pressure.label: fuel_tank_pressure
fuel_tank_pressure.name: Fuel tank pressure
fuel_tank_pressure.description: The internal pressure of the sealed fuel tank, monitored for evaporative emissions control.
fuel_tank_pressure.comment: Abnormal pressure suggests a vapor leak

fuel_type_detected.label: fuel_type_detected
fuel_type_detected.name: Fuel type detected
fuel_type_detected.description: The type and quality grade of fuel identified in the tank.

fuel_filter_status.label: fuel_filter_status
fuel_filter_status.name: Fuel filter status
fuel_filter_status.description: The restriction level of the fuel filter, indicating how soon it needs replacement.
fuel_filter_status.comment: High restriction starves the engine of fuel

exhaust_gas_temperature.label: exhaust_gas_temperature
exhaust_gas_temperature.name: Exhaust gas temperature
exhaust_gas_temperature.description: The temperature of exhaust gases leaving a cylinder bank.
exhaust_gas_temperature.comment: Used to protect the turbo and catalyst

nox_emission_level.label: nox_emission_level
nox_emission_level.name: NOx emission level
nox_emission_level.description: The concentration of nitrogen oxides measured in the exhaust stream.

particulate_filter_status.label: particulate_filter_status
particulate_filter_status.name: Particulate filter status
particulate_filter_status.description: The soot loading and regeneration state of the diesel particulate filter.

catalytic_converter_temperature.label: catalytic_converter_temperature
catalytic_converter_temperature.name: Catalytic converter temperature
catalytic_converter_temperature.description: The operating temperature of the catalytic converter, which must reach a threshold to be effective.

co2_emission_rate.label: co2_emission_rate
co2_emission_rate.name: CO2 emission rate
co2_emission_rate.description: The estimated rate of carbon dioxide emitted per distance traveled.

exhaust_backpressure.label: exhaust_backpressure
exhaust_backpressure.name: Exhaust backpressure
exhaust_backpressure.description: The resistance to exhaust flow measured in the exhaust system.

oxygen_sensor_reading.label: oxygen_sensor_reading
oxygen_sensor_reading.name: Oxygen sensor reading
oxygen_sensor_reading.description: The voltage output of an exhaust oxygen sensor, used to trim the fuel mixture.

egr_valve_position.label: egr_valve_position
egr_valve_position.name: EGR valve position
egr_valve_position.description: The position of the exhaust gas recirculation valve, used to reduce combustion temperatures.
egr_valve_position.comment: A stuck valve raises NOx output

radiator_temperature.label: radiator_temperature
radiator_temperature.name: Radiator temperature
radiator_temperature.description: The temperature of coolant as it passes through the radiator.

coolant_level.label: coolant_level
coolant_level.name: Coolant level
coolant_level.description: The level of coolant remaining in the reservoir.

cooling_fan_status.label: cooling_fan_status
cooling_fan_status.name: Cooling fan status
cooling_fan_status.description: The operating state and speed of the engine cooling fan.

thermostat_position.label: thermostat_position
thermostat_position.name: Thermostat position
thermostat_position.description: How far open the engine thermostat valve currently is.
thermostat_position.comment: Controls coolant flow to the radiator

water_pump_status.label: water_pump_status
water_pump_status.name: Water pump status
water_pump_status.description: The operating state and flow output of the coolant water pump.
water_pump_status.comment: A failed pump causes rapid overheating

radiator_cap_pressure.label: radiator_cap_pressure
radiator_cap_pressure.name: Radiator cap pressure
radiator_cap_pressure.description: The pressure the radiator cap is maintaining in the cooling system.
radiator_cap_pressure.comment: Maintains coolant boiling point under pressure

coolant_leak_detected.label: coolant_leak_detected
coolant_leak_detected.name: Coolant leak detected
coolant_leak_detected.description: Whether a coolant leak has been detected, and its approximate location.

battery_12v_voltage.label: battery_12v_voltage
battery_12v_voltage.name: 12V battery voltage
battery_12v_voltage.description: The voltage of the vehicle's low-voltage starting and accessory battery.

alternator_output.label: alternator_output
alternator_output.name: Alternator output
alternator_output.description: The current and voltage being generated by the alternator to power accessories and charge the battery.
alternator_output.comment: Falls off as the alternator wears

starter_motor_status.label: starter_motor_status
starter_motor_status.name: Starter motor status
starter_motor_status.description: The engagement state and current draw of the starter motor during engine start.
starter_motor_status.comment: High draw can indicate a failing starter

fuse_box_status.label: fuse_box_status
fuse_box_status.name: Fuse box status
fuse_box_status.description: The status of an individual fuse in the vehicle's fuse box.
fuse_box_status.comment: A blown fuse disables its circuit

wiring_harness_integrity.label: wiring_harness_integrity
wiring_harness_integrity.name: Wiring harness integrity
wiring_harness_integrity.description: The measured resistance of a monitored wiring circuit, used to detect chafing or corrosion.
wiring_harness_integrity.comment: Rising resistance suggests a failing connection

ground_connection_status.label: ground_connection_status
ground_connection_status.name: Ground connection status
ground_connection_status.description: The resistance of a chassis ground connection point.

voltage_regulator_status.label: voltage_regulator_status
voltage_regulator_status.name: Voltage regulator status
voltage_regulator_status.description: The output stability of the alternator's voltage regulator.

ignition_switch_position.label: ignition_switch_position
ignition_switch_position.name: Ignition switch position
ignition_switch_position.description: The current position of the ignition switch (off, accessory, run, start).

battery_state_of_charge.label: battery_state_of_charge
battery_state_of_charge.name: Battery state of charge
battery_state_of_charge.description: The remaining usable energy in an electric vehicle's traction battery pack, as a percentage of capacity.
battery_state_of_charge.comment: Only reported by electric fleet vehicles

battery_pack_temperature.label: battery_pack_temperature
battery_pack_temperature.name: Battery pack temperature
battery_pack_temperature.description: The temperature of a cell group within the traction battery pack.
battery_pack_temperature.comment: Thermal management keeps this in a safe band

battery_voltage.label: battery_voltage
battery_voltage.name: Battery voltage
battery_voltage.description: The total voltage output of the traction battery pack.
battery_voltage.comment: Drops slightly as the pack discharges

charging_status.label: charging_status
charging_status.name: Charging status
charging_status.description: Whether the vehicle is currently charging and at what rate.
charging_status.comment: Reported while connected to a charger

regenerative_braking_output.label: regenerative_braking_output
regenerative_braking_output.name: Regenerative braking output
regenerative_braking_output.description: The power being recovered and returned to the battery during regenerative braking.

battery_health.label: battery_health
battery_health.name: Battery health
battery_health.description: The long-term degradation state of the traction battery relative to its original capacity.
battery_health.comment: Declines gradually over the battery's life

inverter_temperature.label: inverter_temperature
inverter_temperature.name: Inverter temperature
inverter_temperature.description: The operating temperature of the power inverter converting battery DC to motor AC.

charging_port_status.label: charging_port_status
charging_port_status.name: Charging port status
charging_port_status.description: Whether a charging connector is plugged into the vehicle, and its type.

tire_pressure_front_left.label: tire_pressure_front_left
tire_pressure_front_left.name: Tire pressure (front left)
tire_pressure_front_left.description: The inflation pressure and tread depth of the front-left tire.
tire_pressure_front_left.comment: One of the most commonly equipped sensors

tire_pressure_front_right.label: tire_pressure_front_right
tire_pressure_front_right.name: Tire pressure (front right)
tire_pressure_front_right.description: The inflation pressure and tread depth of the front-right tire.

tire_pressure_rear_left.label: tire_pressure_rear_left
tire_pressure_rear_left.name: Tire pressure (rear left)
tire_pressure_rear_left.description: The inflation pressure and tread depth of the rear-left tire.
tire_pressure_rear_left.comment: Rear tires often wear differently than front

tire_pressure_rear_right.label: tire_pressure_rear_right
tire_pressure_rear_right.name: Tire pressure (rear right)
tire_pressure_rear_right.description: The inflation pressure and tread depth of the rear-right tire.

wheel_diameter.label: wheel_diameter
wheel_diameter.name: Wheel diameter
wheel_diameter.description: The diameter of the fitted wheel, used to calibrate speed and odometer readings.
wheel_diameter.comment: Changes if a different wheel size is fitted

wheel_speed.label: wheel_speed
wheel_speed.name: Wheel speed
wheel_speed.description: The rotational speed of an individual wheel, used by ABS and traction control.

wheel_alignment_angle.label: wheel_alignment_angle
wheel_alignment_angle.name: Wheel alignment angle
wheel_alignment_angle.description: The camber and toe angle of a wheel relative to the vehicle's chassis.
wheel_alignment_angle.comment: Poor alignment causes uneven tire wear

tire_temperature.label: tire_temperature
tire_temperature.name: Tire temperature
tire_temperature.description: The surface temperature of a tire, which rises with speed and load.

spare_tire_status.label: spare_tire_status
spare_tire_status.name: Spare tire status
spare_tire_status.description: Whether a spare tire is present and its inflation pressure.
spare_tire_status.comment: Not all fleet vehicles carry a spare

brake_pad_wear_front.label: brake_pad_wear_front
brake_pad_wear_front.name: Brake pad wear (front)
brake_pad_wear_front.description: The remaining thickness of the front brake pads, as a percentage of new.
brake_pad_wear_front.comment: Front pads typically wear faster than rear

brake_pad_wear_rear.label: brake_pad_wear_rear
brake_pad_wear_rear.name: Brake pad wear (rear)
brake_pad_wear_rear.description: The remaining thickness of the rear brake pads, as a percentage of new.
brake_pad_wear_rear.comment: Wears more slowly than front pads

brake_fluid_level.label: brake_fluid_level
brake_fluid_level.name: Brake fluid level
brake_fluid_level.description: The level of brake fluid remaining in the reservoir.
brake_fluid_level.comment: Low fluid can indicate a leak or worn pads

brake_temperature.label: brake_temperature
brake_temperature.name: Brake temperature
brake_temperature.description: The temperature of a brake rotor or caliper, which rises under heavy or repeated braking.
brake_temperature.comment: Excess heat can cause brake fade

abs_activation_count.label: abs_activation_count
abs_activation_count.name: ABS activation count
abs_activation_count.description: The number of times the anti-lock braking system has intervened, and the speed of the last intervention.
abs_activation_count.comment: Frequent activation may indicate low-grip conditions

brake_pressure.label: brake_pressure
brake_pressure.name: Brake pressure
brake_pressure.description: The hydraulic pressure applied to the brakes, correlated with pedal position.

parking_brake_status.label: parking_brake_status
parking_brake_status.name: Parking brake status
parking_brake_status.description: Whether the parking brake is currently engaged.

brake_rotor_thickness.label: brake_rotor_thickness
brake_rotor_thickness.name: Brake rotor thickness
brake_rotor_thickness.description: The remaining thickness of a brake rotor, which thins over its service life.

suspension_travel_front.label: suspension_travel_front
suspension_travel_front.name: Suspension travel (front)
suspension_travel_front.description: The current vertical travel of a front suspension corner relative to its resting position.

suspension_travel_rear.label: suspension_travel_rear
suspension_travel_rear.name: Suspension travel (rear)
suspension_travel_rear.description: The current vertical travel of a rear suspension corner relative to its resting position.
suspension_travel_rear.comment: Tracks load and road surface response

shock_absorber_condition.label: shock_absorber_condition
shock_absorber_condition.name: Shock absorber condition
shock_absorber_condition.description: The estimated wear level of a shock absorber based on its damping response.

ride_height.label: ride_height
ride_height.name: Ride height
ride_height.description: The vehicle's current ground clearance, which can vary on adjustable suspension.
ride_height.comment: Lowered ride height may indicate overload

sway_bar_load.label: sway_bar_load
sway_bar_load.name: Sway bar load
sway_bar_load.description: The torsional load currently on the anti-roll (sway) bar during cornering.
sway_bar_load.comment: Rises with lateral load in turns

air_suspension_pressure.label: air_suspension_pressure
air_suspension_pressure.name: Air suspension pressure
air_suspension_pressure.description: The air pressure in an air suspension bag, for vehicles so equipped.

strut_mount_condition.label: strut_mount_condition
strut_mount_condition.name: Strut mount condition
strut_mount_condition.description: Whether a strut mount bushing shows signs of wear or looseness.

steering_angle.label: steering_angle
steering_angle.name: Steering angle
steering_angle.description: The current angle of the steering wheel relative to center.
steering_angle.comment: Used by stability control and ADAS

steering_torque.label: steering_torque
steering_torque.name: Steering torque
steering_torque.description: The torque the driver is applying to the steering wheel.

power_steering_fluid_level.label: power_steering_fluid_level
power_steering_fluid_level.name: Power steering fluid level
power_steering_fluid_level.description: The level of hydraulic fluid in the power steering reservoir, for hydraulic-assist systems.
power_steering_fluid_level.comment: Not applicable to electric power steering

steering_response_time.label: steering_response_time
steering_response_time.name: Steering response time
steering_response_time.description: The measured delay between steering input and a change in vehicle heading.
steering_response_time.comment: Increases can indicate a linkage issue

steering_rack_condition.label: steering_rack_condition
steering_rack_condition.name: Steering rack condition
steering_rack_condition.description: Whether the steering rack shows signs of a fluid leak.

steering_wheel_position_sensor.label: steering_wheel_position_sensor
steering_wheel_position_sensor.name: Steering wheel position sensor
steering_wheel_position_sensor.description: The raw angle reading and calibration state of the steering position sensor.
steering_wheel_position_sensor.comment: Must be recalibrated after alignment work

chassis_stress_level.label: chassis_stress_level
chassis_stress_level.name: Chassis stress level
chassis_stress_level.description: The estimated structural stress on the chassis, from strain gauges on heavy-duty fleet vehicles.
chassis_stress_level.comment: Relevant mainly to trucks and trailers

door_status.label: door_status
door_status.name: Door status
door_status.description: Whether a specific door is currently open or closed.
door_status.comment: One entry per door on the vehicle

window_position.label: window_position
window_position.name: Window position
window_position.description: How far open a specific window currently is.

sunroof_status.label: sunroof_status
sunroof_status.name: Sunroof status
sunroof_status.description: Whether the sunroof is open and by how much.

hood_latch_status.label: hood_latch_status
hood_latch_status.name: Hood latch status
hood_latch_status.description: Whether the hood latch is securely closed.

trunk_latch_status.label: trunk_latch_status
trunk_latch_status.name: Trunk latch status
trunk_latch_status.description: Whether the trunk or cargo door latch is securely closed.

chassis_corrosion_level.label: chassis_corrosion_level
chassis_corrosion_level.name: Chassis corrosion level
chassis_corrosion_level.description: The estimated severity of corrosion detected at a monitored chassis location.
chassis_corrosion_level.comment: More relevant to older fleet vehicles

frame_alignment.label: frame_alignment
frame_alignment.name: Frame alignment
frame_alignment.description: The measured deviation of the vehicle frame from factory specification.
frame_alignment.comment: Large deviations suggest prior collision damage

headlight_status.label: headlight_status
headlight_status.name: Headlight status
headlight_status.description: Whether a headlight is on and its current brightness.

taillight_status.label: taillight_status
taillight_status.name: Taillight status
taillight_status.description: Whether a taillight is currently on.

turn_signal_status.label: turn_signal_status
turn_signal_status.name: Turn signal status
turn_signal_status.description: Whether a turn signal is currently flashing.

hazard_light_status.label: hazard_light_status
hazard_light_status.name: Hazard light status
hazard_light_status.description: Whether the hazard warning lights are currently active.

interior_light_status.label: interior_light_status
interior_light_status.name: Interior light status
interior_light_status.description: Whether an interior cabin light zone is currently on.

fog_light_status.label: fog_light_status
fog_light_status.name: Fog light status
fog_light_status.description: Whether a fog light is currently on.

daytime_running_light_status.label: daytime_running_light_status
daytime_running_light_status.name: Daytime running light status
daytime_running_light_status.description: Whether daytime running lights are active and their brightness.
daytime_running_light_status.comment: Active whenever the vehicle is running

cabin_temperature.label: cabin_temperature
cabin_temperature.name: Cabin temperature
cabin_temperature.description: The measured air temperature within a cabin climate zone.
cabin_temperature.comment: Tracked per zone on dual-zone systems

hvac_fan_speed.label: hvac_fan_speed
hvac_fan_speed.name: HVAC fan speed
hvac_fan_speed.description: The current blower fan speed setting for the climate control system.

air_conditioning_status.label: air_conditioning_status
air_conditioning_status.name: Air conditioning status
air_conditioning_status.description: Whether the air conditioning compressor is active and its current load.
air_conditioning_status.comment: Increases engine or battery load when active

cabin_humidity.label: cabin_humidity
cabin_humidity.name: Cabin humidity
cabin_humidity.description: The relative humidity measured inside the cabin.

air_filter_status.label: air_filter_status
air_filter_status.name: Cabin air filter status
air_filter_status.description: The restriction level of the cabin air filter.

defroster_status.label: defroster_status
defroster_status.name: Defroster status
defroster_status.description: Whether a defroster zone (windshield or rear) is currently active.

seat_heater_status.label: seat_heater_status
seat_heater_status.name: Seat heater status
seat_heater_status.description: Whether a seat heater is active and at what level.

infotainment_volume.label: infotainment_volume
infotainment_volume.name: Infotainment volume
infotainment_volume.description: The current audio volume level of the infotainment system.

gps_signal_strength.label: gps_signal_strength
gps_signal_strength.name: GPS signal strength
gps_signal_strength.description: The strength of the GPS signal, distinct from the position fix itself.

cellular_signal_strength.label: cellular_signal_strength
cellular_signal_strength.name: Cellular signal strength
cellular_signal_strength.description: The strength of the cellular connection used for telematics reporting.
cellular_signal_strength.comment: Weak signal can delay entryset uploads

bluetooth_connection_status.label: bluetooth_connection_status
bluetooth_connection_status.name: Bluetooth connection status
bluetooth_connection_status.description: Whether a Bluetooth device is currently connected.

software_version.label: software_version
software_version.name: Infotainment software version
software_version.description: The currently installed software version of the infotainment head unit.
software_version.comment: Used to track fleet-wide rollout status

wifi_hotspot_status.label: wifi_hotspot_status
wifi_hotspot_status.name: WiFi hotspot status
wifi_hotspot_status.description: Whether the vehicle's onboard WiFi hotspot is active and how many devices are connected.

voice_assistant_status.label: voice_assistant_status
voice_assistant_status.name: Voice assistant status
voice_assistant_status.description: Whether the voice assistant is actively listening and its most recent recognized command.

media_playback_status.label: media_playback_status
media_playback_status.name: Media playback status
media_playback_status.description: The current media source and whether playback is active.

lane_departure_warning_status.label: lane_departure_warning_status
lane_departure_warning_status.name: Lane departure warning status
lane_departure_warning_status.description: Whether the lane departure warning system has recently triggered, and on which side.

forward_collision_warning_status.label: forward_collision_warning_status
forward_collision_warning_status.name: Forward collision warning status
forward_collision_warning_status.description: Whether a forward collision warning is active and the estimated time to collision.

blind_spot_monitor_status.label: blind_spot_monitor_status
blind_spot_monitor_status.name: Blind spot monitor status
blind_spot_monitor_status.description: Whether an object has been detected in a blind spot zone.

adaptive_cruise_control_status.label: adaptive_cruise_control_status
adaptive_cruise_control_status.name: Adaptive cruise control status
adaptive_cruise_control_status.description: Whether adaptive cruise control is engaged and its currently set speed.

driver_attention_level.label: driver_attention_level
driver_attention_level.name: Driver attention level
driver_attention_level.description: An estimated attentiveness score derived from driver-facing camera monitoring.
driver_attention_level.comment: Low scores can trigger an alert

automatic_emergency_braking_status.label: automatic_emergency_braking_status
automatic_emergency_braking_status.name: Automatic emergency braking status
automatic_emergency_braking_status.description: Whether automatic emergency braking has been triggered, and the resulting deceleration.

parking_assist_status.label: parking_assist_status
parking_assist_status.name: Parking assist status
parking_assist_status.description: Whether parking assist is active and the distance to the nearest detected object.

traffic_sign_recognition.label: traffic_sign_recognition
traffic_sign_recognition.name: Traffic sign recognition
traffic_sign_recognition.description: The most recently recognized traffic sign and its associated speed limit.

radar_front.label: radar_front
radar_front.name: Front radar
radar_front.description: Readings from the forward-facing radar unit used for object detection and ranging.

radar_rear.label: radar_rear
radar_rear.name: Rear radar
radar_rear.description: Readings from the rear-facing radar unit used for blind spot and cross-traffic detection.

lidar_roof.label: lidar_roof
